annotations.title: Test several strategies together on one account

description: For a trader running two to five strategies on the same account. Merges their trades by date and reports how often they trade and lose on the same day, the worst day together against alone, whether they tend to win and lose together, and the odds together against each strategy alone on up to three accounts. Every trade needs a close date. Each strategy's profits are scaled from its own starting balance.

challenge_ids.description: Up to three challenge ids. Leave out to use the three accounts where the combination does best.

name.description: A short name for the strategy.

starting_balance.description: The balance this strategy's test started from.

trades.description: Closed trades in the order they closed.

date.description: Close date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give it for every trade or for none.

profit.description: Profit (positive) or loss (negative) in account currency, after costs.

name: check_overlap
title: Test several strategies together on one account
